name: Copenhagen Catalan Film Festival 2022
description:
The 10th edition of the Copenhagen Catalan Film Festival 2022 will take place on 6th November, 19th November and 5th December. Come join us!

*All the movies have English subtitles!*


SUNDAY 06/11/2022 - Grand Teatret
18:45h: Doors open
19:00h: Screening of 'Alcarràs'/ ‘Ferskenlunden i Catalonien’ by Carla Simón (with English subtitles)
21:00h: 'After-film' with drinks and tapas!

Tickets available at: https://grandteatret.dk/film/ferskenlunden-i-catalonien/


SATURDAY 19/11/2022 - Cinemateket
18:30h: Doors open, come enjoy tapas and drinks before the movie!
19:00h: Screening of 'The Odd-Job Men' by Neus Ballús (with English subtitles)
21:00h: TBA

Tickets available at: https://www.dfi.dk/cinemateket/biograf/events/event/catalansk-filmaften-odd-job-men?fbclid=IwAR36saBSwBM8allAvQ9O5sqAZkQbX8cYl5obC1OFpasiesWEBKJrwhujRjs


MONDAY 05/12/2022 - Grand Teatret
Danish premiere of 'One Year, One Night' by Isaki Lacuesta (with English subtitles)
Program details coming soon!
Tickets available at: https://grandteatret.dk/film/ffm22-one-year-one-night/

name: One Year, One Night / Drinks & Tapas/ Catalan Film Festival
description:
Come to the 3rd day and final day of the Copenhagen Catalan Film Festival 2022 at Grand Teatret to watch 'One Year, One Night'! 

We are happy to bring this movie in collaboration with Grand Teatret and Franske Film Mandage 2022. 

After the screening, there will be cava Covides and tapas. 


MOVIE INFO:
Director: 	Isaki Lacuesta
Cast: Nahuel Pérez Biscayart, Noémie Merlant, Quim Gutiérrez, Alba Guilera, Natalia de Molina, C. Tangana
Year: 2022
Length: 120 min
Languages featured: Spanish, French
Original title: 'Un año, una noche'

SYNSOPSIS: 
Céline and Ramón are a young binational couple who survived the terrorist attack at the Bataclan theatre on November 13, 2015. That harrowing night has left an open wound in their lives, and they are struggling to regain a sense of normality and move beyond the identity they have been assigned as victims. While Céline has repressed her experience and thrown herself back into her old life, Ramón is stuck in the past. Both are grappling with the same question: how can they survive and move on as a couple?

TRAILER: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=J9mPm2UyvPs

TICKET SALE: https://grandteatret.dk/film/ffm22-one-year-one-night/
